Packing to Move Checklist

Good packing turns a chaotic move into an orderly one: the right supplies, a room-by-room method, and boxes labelled well enough to unpack without opening them. This checklist keeps your belongings safe and your first night livable. See the rest of our moving and home checklists.

verified Curated by the Gisti team · Updated July 2026

Packing to Move Checklist · 18 items

  • check_box_outline_blank
    Gather supplies: sturdy boxes in a few sizes, packing tape, bubble wrap, packing paper, and markers
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Declutter first — donate, sell, or bin anything you won't use

    Don't pay to move what you'll throw away.

  • check_box_outline_blank
    Pack room by room, finishing one before you start the next
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Label every box with its room and contents, and mark fragile boxes clearly

    Label the sides, not the top — you'll stack them.

  • check_box_outline_blank
    Keep boxes under about 15kg

    Heavy items in small boxes, light items in big ones.

  • check_box_outline_blank
    Wrap breakables individually and fill gaps so nothing shifts
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Use towels, blankets, and clothing as padding to save on bubble wrap
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Keep screws and small parts in labelled bags taped to the furniture they belong to
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Photograph the back of your TV and electronics before unplugging them
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Pack a "first night" essentials box and keep it with you

    Bedding, toiletries, chargers, meds, snacks.

  • check_box_outline_blank
    Pack a separate valuables bag: documents, jewellery, medications, and small electronics you carry yourself
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Empty, clean, and dry appliances, and defrost the freezer at least a day ahead
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Seal liquids in bags and pack them upright to stop leaks
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Keep a "packing kit" of tape, scissors, and a marker you can always find
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Leave clothes on hangers and slip a bin bag over them as a quick wardrobe box
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Either empty drawers or wrap the whole unit closed — don't overpack them
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Count and number your boxes so you know if any go missing
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Load the truck with the heaviest items first and against the cab

Frequently asked questions

How do I pack efficiently for a move? expand_more

Declutter before you pack, gather proper supplies, and work room by room, labelling every box with its room and contents. Keep boxes under about 15kg, use soft items as padding, and pack a "first night" box and a valuables bag you carry yourself.

What should I pack first when moving? expand_more

Start with the rooms and items you use least — off-season clothes, books, spare crockery, décor. Leave daily essentials like kitchen basics, toiletries, and a few clothes for last, and unpack them first at the new place.

How do I keep track of what's in each box? expand_more

Label the sides of every box with the room and a short contents list, number your boxes and keep a running list, and mark fragile ones clearly. A quick photo of a box's contents before you seal it makes unpacking much faster.
